note: The built core is Gearsystem (GPL-3.0-or-later) with this repository's MIT integration, Shay Green's sound buffers (GPL-2.0-or-later and LGPL-2.1-or-later) and miniz (MIT). Its YM2413 (FM sound) emulation is Jarek Burczynski's ym2413.c with Eke-Eke's changes from Genesis Plus GX; the file states no licence of its own, Genesis Plus GX ships it under its non-commercial terms, and MAME ships the original author's code under GPL-2.0-or-later. Until that is settled the package is marked as not for commercial use.
